candidate_a_3x2bit.name: candidate_a_3x2bit_base4
candidate_a_3x2bit.representation: 3 base-4 (2-bit) digits on I in [-22, 21], u = I + 22 = d0 + 4*d1 + 16*d2

symmetry_check.reason: 43 = (3,2,2)_4 in base 4; carry between d1=3 and d2 breaks f(-1-I) = const - f(I)

rejection_reasons: Exceeds the 8-level budget: minimal Hermite cleaning polynomial fixing {0,1,2,3} has degree 7 (depth 3 per iteration). One iteration gives combined residual ~5.4e-5 >> 2^-33 (needs 9 levels total = L19); two iterations reach <2^-33 but require 6+6=12 levels (output L16, violating the L20 hard constraint by 4 levels).

Breaks odd-polynomial symmetry on [-22, 21]: because 43 = (3,2,2)_4 has carries at d1=3, d1 and d2 are not odd around I=-0.5, forcing EvalPolyBatch from kOdd to kNormal (doubling non-zero coefficients per tree).
Cleaning ct-ct multiplications actually increase from 24 to 30 per channel (3 digits * 2 iters * 5 mults for deg-7 vs 6 digits * 2 iters * 2 mults for deg-3).

candidate_b_direct_integer.name: candidate_b_direct_integer_extraction_and_multi_integer_cleaning
candidate_b_direct_integer.representation: Direct integer I in [-22, 21] from Low CtS (x = I + eps, |eps| <= 2^-12), cleaned by a multi-integer polynomial

runge_phenomenon.note: Equispaced Hermite interpolation on [-K, K] suffers catastrophic Runge blowup as K grows; max |H''(k)|/2 already reaches 1.2e3 at K=4 and 7.8e7 at K=8, so 1 iteration diverges for eps=2^-12.

b2_direct_chebyshev_trig_without_double_.target: x - sin(2*pi*x)/(2*pi) on [-21.5, 21.5] (cubic convergence at all integers: (2*pi^2/3)*eps^3 <= 9.57e-11 < 2^-33 at eps=2^-12)
b2_direct_chebyshev_trig_without_double_.fatal_flaw: Evaluating degree-191 Chebyshev polynomial directly on x in [-1, 1] for sin(43*pi*x) has derivative 43*pi ~ 135, amplifying input/rescale noise by 135x (~7.1 bits) and violating the 2^-33 integer residual gate under 58-bit CKKS primes (which is why CKKS EvalMod always uses 1/2^r scaling + r double-angle steps, i.e., Identity19).

rejection_reasons: Algebraic Hermite polynomial fixing all 43 integers [-21, 21] has degree 85 (depth 7 per iteration, 14 levels for 2 iterations > 8-level budget) and suffers catastrophic Runge blowup on equispaced integer nodes (|H''(k)|/2 > 10^7 already at 17 nodes).

Trigonometric periodic cleaning x - sin(2*pi*x)/(2*pi) has cubic convergence at every integer, but without double-angle range reduction it requires degree ~191 (depth 8) with slope 43*pi ~ 135 that amplifies CKKS rescale noise by ~7 bits; with double-angle range reduction (6+2=8 levels), it degenerates into standard trigonometric EvalMod (Identity19) rather than Discrete EvalRound.
